title: Personal Loan Intake and Initial Review Record
subtitle: A controlled intake for an unsecured or secured personal borrowing request, including stated purpose, amount, term, repayment capacity, existing obligations, collateral if offered, and applicant communications, carrying the record from secure identity and evidence through qualified decision, exception escalation, customer communication, and accountable closeout.
description: Original high-value Personal Loan workflow for an unsecured or secured personal borrowing request, including stated purpose, amount, term, repayment capacity, existing obligations, collateral if offered, and applicant communications. It is designed to open one controlled record, distinguish an inquiry from an actionable request, capture relevant facts and evidence status, triage stop conditions, assign review, and document the next accepted handoff while minimizing sensitive data and preserving a defensible evidence trail.
use_case: Use when a consumer lending specialist must open one controlled record, distinguish an inquiry from an actionable request, capture relevant facts and evidence status, triage stop conditions, assign review, and document the next accepted handoff for one loan request. Closure requires a supported outcome, secure evidence references, customer or recipient communication, disposition of every exception, and an accountable handoff.

sections.title: Personal Loan intake identity and routing
sections.guidance: Open one traceable record, use secure references, and assign an accountable qualified owner before collecting or changing financial information.

blocks.label: Personal Loan record and responsible parties
Intake and Initial Review Record timing and route
Secure-record boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not enter Social Security numbers, login credentials, full account or routing numbers, full credit-report contents, authentication secrets, or source documents here. Store sensitive evidence only in the approved system and record its secure reference.

sections.title: Personal Loan facts and evidence for intake
sections.guidance: Capture facts specific to this financial workflow, distinguish stated from verified information, and leave an evidence route for every material conclusion.

blocks.label: Personal Loan transaction or account profile
Personal Loan evidence checkpoints
items: Loan purpose and intended use are recorded in the applicant's own terms
Requested amount and preferred repayment period are distinguishable
Income source and frequency are recorded without unsupported conclusions
Housing expense and material recurring obligations are identified
Existing relationship and prior-loan references use secure system IDs
Any offered collateral is described without treating it as approved
Applicant communication preference and accessibility needs are routed
Credit inquiry consent and identity verification are stored by reference
blocks.guidance: Check only when the item is present, current, and linked. Describe limitations or contradictions in the exception record.

blocks.label: Personal Loan quantitative and source-evidence register
blocks.guidance: Use one row per material input or evidence item; preserve the source period and verification status.

blocks.label: Applicant goals, timing, repayment concerns, collateral context, and facts that a qualified reviewer should understand

fields.label: Personal Loan context and evidence limitations

sections.title: Personal Loan intake analysis and control record
sections.guidance: Use the blocks below to open one controlled record, distinguish an inquiry from an actionable request, capture relevant facts and evidence status, triage stop conditions, assign review, and document the next accepted handoff. Preserve objective evidence, uncertainty, ownership, and due points.

blocks.label: Request definition and triage
Initial conversation and intake controls
items: The applicant describes the requested outcome in their own words
The loan request is classified before any decision or execution
Material dates, amounts, parties, and assumptions are read back for confirmation
Stated information is visibly separated from verified evidence
Only necessary information is requested through an approved secure channel
Language access, accommodation, representative, and contact preferences are routed
No promise of approval, pricing, timing, settlement, or outcome is made
Urgent, suspicious, disputed, or protected-process matters are escalated

blocks.label: Initial question, response, and evidence map
Neutral intake summary, open questions, and proposed next step

sections.title: Personal Loan stop conditions, exceptions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Stop processing when authority, identity, evidence, safety, legality, fairness, privacy, fraud, or financial-crime controls are unresolved. Record facts rather than unsupported conclusions.

blocks.label: Stop and escalate when any condition is present
items: Identity or contact information conflicts with the secure customer profile
Income amount, source, or frequency is incomplete or materially inconsistent
Material recurring obligations appear omitted or cannot be reconciled
Loan purpose is unclear, prohibited by policy, or inconsistent with evidence
Applicant reports pressure, coercion, impersonation, or third-party control
Protected-class information is being requested or used outside an approved process
Collateral ownership, lien position, or valuation needs specialist review
Repayment-capacity conclusion lacks documented inputs or qualified review
Request cannot be classified as inquiry, application, servicing request, or payment instruction
Required identity, authority, contact, or secure-system reference is missing
blocks.guidance: A checked item requires an immediate protective action, named owner, qualified review route, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Intake and Initial Review Record exception and escalation register
Objective facts, affected activity, containment, notifications, and review needed
Qualified-review and record boundary
blocks.guidance: This template records operational facts and does not determine legal rights, creditworthiness, regulatory duties, fraud, sanctions status, or professional conclusions. Follow current institution policy and applicable requirements; route legal, compliance, underwriting, fraud, tax, accounting, or other professional questions to authorized reviewers.

sections.title: Personal Loan decision, conditions, and accountable authorization
sections.guidance: Record the qualified decision separately from preliminary analysis, identify every condition, and prevent execution beyond the approved scope.

blocks.label: Intake and Initial Review Record qualified decision
Personal Loan decision and execution conditions
items: Request type, owner, service level, and next decision point are explicit
Unverified statements are not represented as verified evidence
Approved amount, pricing, term, and fees match the qualified decision record
Any collateral condition is verified through the approved secured-loan process
Required disclosures and applicant notices are issued by the authorized channel
Credit decision reasons are specific, supportable, and handled under policy
No blank signature, unsupported promise, or unapproved exception remains
Funding is blocked until all approval conditions show completed evidence
blocks.guidance: Check only controls supported by cited evidence; unresolved items remain open conditions.

blocks.label: Evidence considered, reasons, limits, alternatives, and required follow-up
Preparation, qualified review, and independent authorization
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and scope; they do not replace required agreements, disclosures, notices, or system approvals.

blocks.label: Decision-use limitation
blocks.guidance: Do not use this Personal Loan record as a substitute for a required application, contract, disclosure, adverse-action notice, payment instruction, credit report, or specialist determination. Execute only the action evidenced in the approved system of record.

sections.title: Personal Loan completion, evidence reconciliation, and handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when the outcome is evidenced, remaining limitations are visible, customer communication is traceable, and every open action has an accountable owner.

blocks.label: Intake and Initial Review Record outcome and primary handoff
Personal Loan closeout evidence
items: Final decision and specific conditions are linked to the applicant record
Applicant communication and required notice delivery are evidenced
Approved terms are separated from scenarios and preliminary estimates
Unmet conditions have an owner, due point, and escalation disposition
Funding or non-funding outcome is reconciled to the decision
Retention class and secure evidence location are assigned
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items require an exception disposition or a documented reopen trigger.
